classification: Adopted reference contract (2026-09-13 user instruction); not an in-game numerical oracle

interpretation.gainNpBuffIndividualSum: For each resolved recipient, count matching active buff instances. Passive inclusion requires an explicit flag. Each matching instance contributes once, independently of actor intrinsic traits.
interpretation.gainNpIndividualSum: Counts buff instances plus matching intrinsic individualities across the selected actor scope. Not implemented by the buff-count branch.
interpretation.gainNpTargetSum: Counts matching actors across the selected scope. Not implemented by the buff-count branch.
interpretation.scope: Value2 is an actor-scope selector for IndividualSum/TargetSum, not an amount cap.
interpretation.buffTraits: BuffData.getTraits combines buff.vals with cell-added individualities. IgnoreIndividuality removes an instance from this reader; irremovable instances are still counted. The implemented branch rejects these extra lifetime/identity policies and counts only ordinary active, removable instances.

adoptedContract.recipient: gainNpPerBuffIndividual reads each resolved recipient independently, counts active matching instances once, excludes IgnoreIndividuality, then adds Value * count; zero count performs no resource change.
adoptedContract.identity: BuffData.getTraits uses buff.vals, not the addIndividuality Value. Callback signatures are catalogued without executing turn-end or after-attack callbacks during preparation.
adoptedContract.bound: AddState.checkSameBuffLimitNum counts all valid matching instances, including constant buffs, and rejects the new grant at the cap. A physical input bound is adopted only when all catalogued producers and cells agree on an explicit cap; growth is 10. Missing or conflicting caps cannot bound uncapped stack readers.
adoptedContract.stackRead: BuffData.getValue reads matching buff traits including constant buffs. NP count reads active buffs only. Both use one initial input and instance store; grant/removal updates subsequent reads. Actor intrinsic traits are not seeded as buff instances.
adoptedContract.referenceCallback: An attackBeforeFunction whose referenced functions only grant upCriticaldamage is retained as a resolved reference with no terminal NP damage contribution.
adoptedContract.boundedScope: Only ordinary active/constant instances and explicit matching grant caps. Unbound, mixed, finite-use, ignored, unremovable, or moving instances remain fail closed where they can affect this count.

countUnits.gainNpTargetSum: One per matching actor (OR over selected traits), including intrinsic and added individualities.
countUnits.gainNpIndividualSum: Matching intrinsic/added individualities plus eligible buff instances, including multiplicity.

populationCountFollowup.identity: Actor individuality (including addIndividuality Value) and buff identity (buff.vals) are separate canonical selector bases. Mixed identity/unknown overlap remains unsupported. canBeInBattle is normalized only in the pipeline to a population-presence selector.
populationCountFollowup.input: Initial additional ally/enemy population is 0..2 each, excluding the attacker/current NP target. Actor-trait counts concern only these additional actors; buff counts concern the entire selected scope. Known actors are read from current canonical traits. Impossible initial counts are repairable inputRequired.
populationCountFollowup.execution: Selected sources append ordered population events inside the existing NP/OC transaction. Full cohort grants can be counted exactly. Unknown partial actor overlap, conditional/finite/opaque writers and relevant unbound removals fail closed; rejected transactions preserve prior state.
populationCountFollowup.ranking: Legal joint count/population tuples; capacity saturation of positive gain readers and a shared-execution terminal OC interval may prove input equivalence. Per-profile cap4096 is unchanged. Baseline6 profiles pass; the remaining count profile and satisfied-policy candidate limits are not closed.
populationCountFollowup.unresolved502600: Negative Rate in add_state.dart requires the immediately preceding per-target function result. Counter20887 additionally requires happyHalloween. Current aggregate inputs cannot justify unconditional all-target marker grants, so execution remains unsupported.
